newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing stock accounts reach 788,000 at end-April.
newsitem.headline: Beijing stock accounts reach 788,000 at end-April.

text.p: Investors in China's capital Beijing had a total of 788,000 stock trading accounts by the end of April, the Beijing Economic Daily said on Wednesday.

In the month of April alone, residents opened about 57,000 new accounts at various securities firms in Beijing, the newspaper quoted statistics from the local securities registration corporation as showing.
